Get Started

IPVanish VPN Features

With privacy protection from IPVanish, you’ll have all the VPN features you need to help secure your data, devices, and connections.

Get Started

Now at IPVanish!

RAM Servers

RAM-only servers run entirely on volatile memory rather than hard drives, ensuring data is physically incapable of being stored after a system reset. This setup enhances privacy, strengthens security, and allows faster performance updates across the IPVanish network.

Double Hop VPN

Double Hop VPN routes your traffic through two IPVanish VPN servers instead of one, adding an extra layer of security to your online activities. Creating a double-encrypted connection helps increase privacy and tracking protection, allowing for a safer browsing experience when you need it the most.

Threat Protection Pro

Threat Protection Pro is a built-in solution that blocks malware, phishing, malicious downloads, ads, and trackers in real time—even without a VPN connection—providing automatic, always-on security.

Automatic Startup

Automatic startup (included in ‘On Demand’ for iOS users) ensures your VPN connection activates as soon as internet traffic is detected on your device. This feature offers convenience and continuous protection without manual intervention. It’s beneficial for consistently maintaining a secure connection, as it starts securing the moment your device connects to the internet, whether upon device startup, a background application launch, or while switching networks. This means you’re protected by your VPN when you need it most, providing peace of mind and enhanced security for all your online activities.

Threat Protection Pro

Threat Protection Pro delivers advanced, real-time security for your device. It goes beyond basic blocking to actively monitor files, apps, and network activity—stopping malware, ransomware, malicious downloads, and suspicious behavior before they can cause harm. With always-on protection and on-demand or scheduled scans, it provides a deeper layer of defense that works even when your VPN is disconnected.

Threat Protection

IPVanish Threat Protection blocks everyday online threats before they reach you. Using DNS-level filtering, it stops ads, trackers, and known malicious websites from loading—helping you browse faster, reduce interruptions, and protect your privacy. Available on all devices and plans, it’s a simple, lightweight way to stay safer online wherever you use IPVanish VPN.

VPN Kill Switch

A VPN Kill Switch is a critical security failsafe built to better ensure your VPN privacy. If your VPN connection unexpectedly drops, the VPN Kill Switch activates, instantly suspending all internet traffic to and from your device. This immediate action ensures that your data remains protected, preventing any exposure or vulnerability that could occur during lapses in your VPN connection. It’s an essential tool for maintaining continuous security, especially when dealing with sensitive information. Gain peace of mind knowing that your online activities remain confidential even in the face of connection leaks and network disruptions.

TV Kill Switch App

While recognizing some systems’ limitations with simultaneous VPN tunneling and network kill switches, IPVanish has an innovative answer to the challenge. Our development team crafted a unique solution: the IPVanish TV Kill Switch App. This dynamic companion app to IPVanish VPN significantly enhances the protective capabilities of our primary VPN service. Specifically designed for environments where traditional VPN features face constraints, this app helps ensure that your privacy is never compromised, providing a failsafe for any network disruption on your Fire TV or Android TV devices.

On Demand

Our iOS On Demand feature allows you to activate IPVanish VPN whenever you connect to the internet, but it does more than that, too. On Demand allows you to establish rules for how your VPN automatically operates. You can pre-select which networks you recognize as safe, choose whether to automatically trust or secure cellular networks, and even add specific web domains to initiate a VPN connection automatically. This flexibility allows iPhone, iPad, and Vision Pro owners to seamlessly integrate IPVanish VPN into their daily internet use and achieve maximum privacy protection in the process.

Split Tunneling By App

Split tunneling revolutionizes your privacy by enabling selective application routing for a customized online setup. This VPN feature allows you to choose which apps use the VPN for enhanced security and which connect directly to the internet for better performance. It’s ideal for managing bandwidth, accessing geo-restricted content while maintaining local network connectivity, and balancing security with efficiency. By customizing your connection, split tunneling meets diverse digital needs, from securely streaming media to maintaining the fastest access to local services.

Split Tunneling By Domain

Split tunneling by domain transforms your privacy experience by providing selective website routing options in your personal VPN setup. This functionality empowers you to designate specific websites that can function independently of the VPN, optimizing their performance while ensuring the security of the rest of your network traffic. Available for our Windows, macOS, iOS, and visionOS VPN apps, this feature is beneficial for bandwidth management, preserving access to local connections, and striking a balance between security and efficiency.

VPN Shortcuts

Enhance your streaming experience with our VPN Shortcuts feature, available on Android TV and Fire TV apps. Shortcuts allow you to pair a VPN server location with a specific app so you can launch them with a single click from the Home screen. Set up to three shortcuts for quick access to streamline your navigation and enjoy seamless connectivity.

Double Hop VPN

Double Hop VPN is an advanced privacy feature designed to fortify your online security by routing your traffic through not one but two VPN servers in different locations. Also known as “multi-hop VPN” or “double VPN,” this dual-layer protection makes it much harder for ISPs, hackers, or other third parties to trace your online activity or uncover your IP address. With IPVanish, you can customize your Double Hop VPN path by choosing from over 150 global server locations, adding an extra layer of security to your connection for safer, more private browsing wherever you are. 

Default Location

Get a fast VPN connection without the guesswork. Our Default Location feature automatically selects the best available VPN server based on your proximity, network conditions, and server load. Whether you’re browsing, streaming, or gaming, this ensures you always connect to the best VPN server for top performance. Just tap to Default Location to connect, and let IPVanish handle the rest.

RAM Servers

RAM-only servers enhance your privacy by running entirely on volatile memory rather than traditional hard drives. Because no data is ever written to disk, even anonymous session information is automatically wiped whenever a server is powered off or rebooted. This design eliminates any possible risk of storage, ensuring that third parties cannot recover your activity. With IPVanish, our network combines RAM-only and HDD servers worldwide, providing stronger privacy protections, faster updates, and reliable performance, regardless of your connection location.

Network Features

3,400+ Servers in 150+ VPN Locations

IPVanish operates an extensive network of over 3,400 VPN servers across more than 150 VPN locations worldwide.

This vast range of servers lets you choose your virtual location, giving you complete control over your online presence. Whether traveling or seeking access to websites from different parts of the world, the VPN helps ensure a secure and high-speed connection is always within reach. With IPVanish, a safe online experience can be found, no matter your geographic location.

Show more

SOCKS5 Proxy

Our SOCKS5 proxy is a technology designed to enhance your internet experience by combining increased speed with improved IP address privacy.

Unlike more traditional proxies, SOCKS5 does not include encryption, which means it can offer faster speeds, making it an excellent choice for activities where speed is crucial but privacy and security less so. This proxy type provides a more flexible and efficient way to mask your IP address, offering a layer of anonymity without the overhead of encryption found in VPNs. The SOCKS5 proxy stands out as a versatile option for those who prioritize speed and simplicity while still seeking a degree of privacy in their online activities.

Show more

High-Speed Surfing

Enjoy all the benefits of VPN without sacrificing your speed in the process. Our VPN service has been engineered to provide the quickest connections possible.

This means faster browsing, faster downloads, and faster streaming, all while maintaining robust security and privacy. Whether you’re engaging in everyday internet browsing, streaming high-definition content, or conducting large file transfers, our VPN provides the speed you want without compromising on the security you need. 

Show more

Shared IP Addresses

IPVanish enhances online anonymity by providing over 56,000 shared IP addresses. These IP addresses are dynamic and shared amongst all subscribers.

This makes it nearly impossible to trace online activities back to any individual user. This approach also significantly masks your identity and online location, ultimately increasing your privacy. Shared IP addresses are an effective way to blend your digital footprint with other users, offering more anonymity and security in your online interactions.

Show more

DNS Leak Protection

DNS leak protection is an essential security feature that is automatically enabled in our service to safeguard your online privacy.

All your internet traffic, including website requests, is securely routed through the VPN’s encrypted tunnel. This built-in leak protection prevents DNS queries from being exposed to external networks, effectively concealing your true location and internet activities from potential eavesdroppers. Keeping your DNS requests within the private network helps ensure that your online identity and location details remain confidential.

Show more

Multiple Connection Protocols

IPVanish offers a range of VPN protocols, including WireGuard®, OpenVPN, IKEv2, and IPSec, catering to diverse speed, obfuscation, and security requirements.

This variety allows users to select the protocol that best suits their needs, whether prioritizing faster connection speeds, enhanced security, enhanced privacy, or a balance of both. WireGuard® offers cutting-edge speed and security, OpenVPN is renowned for its flexibility and Scramble properties, IKEv2 is known for its speed and stability on mobile devices, and IPSec is widely used for its strong encryption capabilities. This protocol variety ensures that IPVanish users can enjoy a tailored VPN experience optimized for their individual online activities.

VPN For Every Device

Get the data protection you deserve for every device you own with VPN apps supporting all major platforms. From desktop to mobile VPN, tablets, smart TVs, VPN routers, and more, IPVanish has your protection covered. Our expansive range of supported devices ensures that no matter what setup you have, you can enjoy the benefits of a secure, private internet connection. We understand the diversity of today’s digital ecosystem, and our goal is to provide an effortless VPN experience on any device you own.

Dedicated Streaming Apps

When we say VPN for every device, we mean it. We proudly offer specialized apps for streaming-specific devices, including Apple TV, Fire TV, and Android TV. This commitment to innovation is exemplified by being the first major VPN provider to offer a dedicated Apple TV app. Our apps are designed to integrate easily with your streaming devices, ensuring you can enjoy your favorite content with enhanced privacy and without compromising speed or quality. Whether you’re catching up on the latest series, watching a live sports event, or streaming a movie, you’ll experience a more secure connection explicitly tailored to the streaming needs of today.

Secure Media Access

Secure media access through our VPN service ensures that your online media consumption details and habits remain under wraps. It allows you to safely access your favorite websites and services anytime, enhancing your browsing experience with an additional layer of security. Whether you’re streaming, downloading, or simply exploring the web, IPVanish keeps your activities shielded from prying eyes, offering you the freedom to enjoy the World Wide Web as you desire, with the peace of mind that comes from knowing your data is more secure.

Encrypted Network Access

IPVanish safeguards your online presence with end-to-end encryption, making any connection to the internet safer in the process. This advanced encryption shields your activities from snoopers, advertisers, Man-in-the-Middle attacks, and more, helping ensure your traffic remains hidden from any onlookers. Whether browsing at home, using public Wi-Fi, or out on the go, IPVanish’s advanced encryption standards keep your data safer and more private, offering a reliable layer of security for your internet activities.

Unmetered Connections

At IPVanish, we’re dedicated to enhancing your online privacy across all your devices. To achieve this, we provide an unmetered number of simultaneous connections for each IPVanish account. This unique benefit allows you to connect multiple devices to our VPN network at the same time without restriction. Whether it’s your phone, tablet, laptop, or even your entire household’s devices, you can keep them safe all under a single account. This policy offers you complete flexibility and convenience. You no longer have to sacrifice the security of one device to defend another; with IPVanish, every device you own can enjoy the same level of protection.

Money-Back Guarantee

We stand firmly behind the quality and reliability of IPVanish. To prove it, we allow new users to try IPVanish risk-free. With our 30-day money-back guarantee, all our Yearly and 2-Year plans are eligible for a full refund within 30 days of purchase. This policy is our way of confirming your complete satisfaction with our service. If, for any reason, you find that IPVanish does not meet your expectations, we’ll give you your money back, no questions asked. Our guarantee is designed to give you peace of mind and confidence in our commitment to providing a top-notch VPN experience.

Verified No Logs

At IPVanish, privacy isn’t just a feature; it’s our core principle. We are deeply committed to ensuring your online activities remain exclusively yours. That’s why our VPN service operates under a strict zero logs policy, which has been independently verified for ultimate trust and transparency. This policy means that your internet traffic, browsing history, and online activities are never monitored, logged, or stored by our VPN apps at any moment. Our commitment to a verified no-logs policy reinforces our dedication to safeguarding your privacy and ensuring you have the utmost freedom and confidentiality in your online experiences.

24/7 Support

Our ‘round-the-clock IPVanish support guarantees that help is always a click or call away, any time of the day. With a team of seasoned experts available via live chat, email, and phone (standard business hours), we provide quick assistance for all your VPN queries and issues. This 24/7 service includes access to a comprehensive knowledge database with FAQs and in-depth tutorials designed to guide you through every aspect of your VPN experience. Whether you’re navigating setup challenges, seeking optimization tips, or need quick solutions, our support team is committed to offering prompt, reliable, knowledgeable assistance that enhances your service experience.

How VPN Works: Step-by-step

1

App Launch

You open the IPVanish VPN app, which acts as a control center for your online privacy.

2

Server Connection

When you select a server, your device creates a secure connection to it. This server acts as a middleman for your internet activities.

3

Data Tunneling and Encryption

Your data travels through an encrypted ‘tunnel’ to the server. Encryption transforms the data into a code to prevent unauthorized access, ensuring that your online actions are private and secure.

4

IP Address Shielding

The server assigns you a new IP address, concealing your actual location and identity. This makes it difficult for websites and advertisers to track you.

5

Secure Browsing

As you browse the internet, the VPN server processes your requests, maintaining your anonymity. Your data appears to originate from the VPN server, not your device.

6

Data Return

The encrypted data is sent back to you through the secure tunnel, maintaining privacy and security throughout the process.
